changelog:
v0.2.3
- Fixed API-key-only connector access when MediaForge session authentication is enabled
- Added a regression test proving Jellyfin does not need a MediaForge browser session
- Kept missing or invalid scoped API keys denied with HTTP 401

v0.2.2
- Fixed access to MediaForge URL and API-key settings
- Made the settings page Jellyfin's default plugin page
- Explicitly registered the MediaForge module under Module Settings
- Added configuration-page regression tests

v0.2.1
- Fixed the Requests sidebar entry for all signed-in users
- Applied sidebar setting changes immediately
- Added compatibility for current Jellyfin drawer layouts
- Added authorization and injection regression tests

v0.2.0
- Added Jellyfin repository and automatic updates
- Added user-visible download progress
- Added pending-request withdrawal
- Added security and concurrency hardening
description: Searches the movie and TV sources enabled in MediaForge directly from Jellyfin. Users can request downloads; administrators can approve them or enable automatic mode.
name: MediaForge Requests
overview: MediaForge search and download requests for all Jellyfin users
